t: The $(item)Display Shelf/$ functions exactly like its bigger brother the $(l:machines/display_table)Display Table/$, but is half-height. In addition, it will not render its legs if the block beneath it does not have a solid top face.
$(item)展示台/$的功能与它的大哥$(l:machines/display_table)展示桌/$完全相同，但只有半格高。此外，如果其下方的方块顶部表面不坚实，它将不会渲染桌腿。
